observed_fact: The deterministic contract harness proves the required state-machine invariants, but Builder Chat has no demonstrated transient Site store, persistent backend process, restart control, live stream cursor, or lease-bearing worker connection on the actual Site platform. notes: The local 11/11 result is preparatory proof, not a platform PASS. GitHub was not used as a heartbeat or transient event store.
